text:
alex: hey team :wave: quick question — where's the canonical Grafana/dashboard for GPU SM% (per-pool), GPU memory, and KV cache hit/eviction metrics? Need to tune batch_size for an incoming canary and want to check history + alerts before I run it.

maya: short answer: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/gpu-overview | use the `GPU - per pool` row. Panels to check: 'SM Utilization (SM%)' (panel id 17), 'GPU Memory by Pod' (panel id 21), 'KV Cache: hitrate & evictions' (panel id 34). Also we have a smaller cached view for canary runs: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/canary-gpu-view | panel ids 3/4. :mag_right:

kevin: adding context — for batch_size tuning look at two things: SM% sustained vs tail (p95/p99) and kv cache hitrate per pool. If kv hitrate drops below ~70% when you increase batch_size, you'll see memory pressure and evictions climb. For alerts we currently have:
- sm_utilization_high: triggers at SM% >= 90% for 5m
- kv_eviction_rate: triggers at evictions_per_min >= 50 for 1m
- gpu_memory_swap: triggers at gpu_memory_free_pct <= 10% for 2m

If you want, I can propose a canary-aware alert tweak (looser p95 window) while you test.

sophie: who owns the GPU dashboard panels now? tagging @kevin since he touched them last quarter.

kevin: yep owner is me for the gpu-overview dashboard. I'll take a quick look and make a small dashboard link with the canary panels and share a short runbook.

alex: perfect — can you also paste the minimal alert rule snippet I should temporarily relax for the canary? want to avoid noisy pages.

kevin: sure — here's the short patch we used previously (Datadog format):
```yaml
- name: gpu-sm-util-canary
  query: "avg(last_5m):avg:gpu.sm_util{pool:canary} by {pool} > 92"
  conditions:
    - threshold: 92
      timeframe: 10m
      operator: "above"
  notify: false  # temporary, set to true after canary
  silenced_until: null
```
Set `notify: false` and run for the canary window (30m-1h). I'll open a PR with that change and a link to the canary dashboard.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: PR #2384 merged (grafana/canary-panels) — https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/2384 :white_check_mark:

ops-oncall: FYI if you end up needing traces, use the `inference-gpu` trace tag in Datadog/APM. Example: https://app.datadoghq.com/apm/traces?query=inference-gpu | set span filter to `kv/cache` and look for `kv.cache.miss` events.

alex: awesome, thanks. one more quick ask — command to grab recent kube logs for the pool so I can correlate evictions?

maya: `kubectl -n inference logs -l pool=canary --tail=500 --since=30m` 
Also `rg "evict|eviction|kvcache"` against the logs if you have them locally.

kevin: i'll update the alert thresholds in the PR to include a canary toggle and add a note in the runbook about what to revert. Expect a ping from me in ~20m after I finish the dashboard splice.

alex: thanks all — will kick off the canary once kevin pings. will share results in this thread. :thumbsup:

sophie: thanks — ping me if you want me to watch the page.

alex: will do.

(threads are short; i'll post the canary link here when started)
